summary: DECIDED in Wave 35, NOT APPLIED. The stale blocker is retired: `main` IS branch-protected (GET returns 200, not 404). The seven enforcement questions this handoff asked are now answered with a written decision and rationale in REL-003 and CP-077, and the exact owner procedure is in docs/audits/flow-notes/release-wave35-governance-2026-09-25.md section 2.3. The structural gap is closed in the repository: ci.yml was restructured from one composite job into eleven independent jobs so the production build, migration gates and service-role audit are no longer steps masked behind a typecheck failure. NO branch-protection setting was changed and NO PUT was issued by this lane.
completed: Retired the recorded `404 Branch not protected` baseline for `main`. Both STATE.md and RELEASE-005 still carry it; the live configuration is now: strict required_status_checks (10 contexts), required_approving_review_count 1, dismiss_stale_reviews true, require_last_push_approval true, enforce_admins true, required_linear_history true, allow_force_pushes false, allow_deletions false, required_conversation_resolution true.

Captured the exact required-check set and mapped each against RELEASE-005 acceptance criterion 3 (clean install, lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, production build, migration checks, service-role audit, security scan, critical E2E).

Established that three required checks are the actual merge blockers on PR #14: `Database Types` (FAILURE), `Lint And Build` (FAILURE), `E2E Tests (Playwright)` (CANCELLED). mergeStateStatus is BLOCKED, and nothing else contributes.
Established that the `Vercel` failure and the Advanced Security `CodeQL` failure do NOT block the merge, because neither is a required check.

WAVE 35 ANSWER 1 - required-check posture decided (REL-003, CP-077). Require: Dependency review, Production Build, Migration Gates, Service-Role Audit, Jest Unit Tests, Route And Registry Gates, Regression Safeguards. Do NOT require as configured: Migrations And RLS Matrix, mobile-checks, redirect-safety, Mobile Typecheck And Lint (all four are PATH-FILTERED, and a required context that does not report for a head SHA BLOCKS the merge - requiring any of them would brick main on the first unrelated pull request). Defer: the Advanced Security CodeQL gate, until a refs/heads/main baseline exists and the alert backlog is dispositioned. Leave required_signatures false; recommend the owner enable it.

WAVE 35 ANSWER 2 - the structural gap is closed in-repo, not just reported. .github/workflows/ci.yml now has 11 independent jobs with no needs: edges. The production build (step 27), check:migration-validation (step 12), check:service-role-allowlist (step 15) and check:admin-audit (step 16) were all skipped on run 35761777731 behind the step 11 typecheck failure; they now report their own conclusions. A mechanical before/after set difference of every npm invocation returns 0 removed and 0 added, and npm audit --audit-level=critical moved AHEAD of typecheck so it is no longer maskable.

WAVE 35 ANSWER 3 - the procedure is a single atomic PUT, not a sequence. GitHub REPLACES required_status_checks.contexts wholesale rather than appending, so current-10 plus 6 new is one operation with no interim window in which enforcement is weaker than today. Executing it as partial edits is what would create such a window. Timing constraint recorded: the six new contexts only start reporting once a pull request runs the restructured ci.yml, so the PUT must land in the same window as the merge that carries the restructure, or immediately after it.

WAVE 35 CONSTRAINT DISCOVERED - four of the ten required contexts (Security exception governance, Secret scan, CodeQL (JavaScript/TypeScript), Generate SBOM) are emitted ONLY by .github/workflows/security-scans.yml, WHICH IS NOT ON main. git ls-tree --name-only origin/main .github/workflows/ returns 13 files and security-scans.yml is not among them; it was introduced in commit be313ca2 (2026-08-04) on an unmerged feature branch. They are currently satisfiable only because a pull request carries that file. There is zero evidence their push:main path has ever run, and removing the file from main would make four required contexts unproducible and block every future merge.
next_steps: EXECUTE the single atomic PUT in section 2.3 of docs/audits/flow-notes/release-wave35-governance-2026-09-25.md, in the same window as the merge that carries the ci.yml restructure. Read the current set programmatically, build current+6, PUT once, read back. Do not hand-type the context list.

Merge a branch carrying .github/workflows/security-scans.yml to main, then confirm GET /repos/KyleQD/Tourify/code-scanning/analyses?ref=refs/heads/main is non-empty. That single check is what proves the baseline defect is closed. Until then the Advanced Security CodeQL gate is not a valid regression gate. Full five-step procedure in REL-004 / evidence record section 3.4.

Then re-read the platform gate. Expect its absolute open-alert count on main - not 96 - to be the real pre-existing backlog for HF-RELEASE-SEC-CODEQL, and expect the reported NEW-alert count on the next pull request to drop sharply. That number is the triage list; it must not be reduced by dismissal (CP-060).

Decide whether to widen or remove the path filters on admin-rls-ci.yml, mobile-ci.yml and mobile-redirect-safety.yml. Until one of those happens, the migration and mobile gates cannot be required at all. Widening is release-owned but was not done: it puts a ~3-minute Supabase stack boot and a second mobile dependency install on every pull request, and that cost/benefit call is the owner's.
Decide whether to enable required_signatures. Left false and recorded as false.
blockers: NO branch-protection mutation was made. Every item above is a hosted change to main and needs owner authorization and owner execution. This lane issued no PUT and changed no protection state.

The six new required contexts do not exist on any pull request until a pull request runs the restructured ci.yml. Adding them to the required set before that first run blocks the next merge with six non-reporting contexts. This is the one hard sequencing constraint in this handoff.
Hosted exact-SHA QA-003 certification, deployment evidence, approver, and rollback point remain outstanding and are unaffected by the protection posture.

E2E Tests (Playwright) was CANCELLED on d2176904. That remains a required check and therefore a merge blocker, and it is not a branch-protection question: it fails because next build runs an inline full-repo tsc while typecheck is red. Owner-side budget headroom is raised separately in HF-QA-035-E2E-BUILD-HEADROOM.
